cases.purpose: A written design drives image generation, and both are returned.
constraints: Returns a written visual design proposal for a children's library poster
Returns one poster image for a children's library
The poster image follows the written proposal
The poster image contains no text
cases.prompt: Design a poster for a children's library. First write a visual design proposal, then generate the image. Do not include any text in the image.

cases.purpose: A style read from a reference image conditions a new image on a different subject.
constraints: Returns a description of the reference image's style
Returns one image of a cafe
The cafe image uses the described style
The cafe image shows a cafe, not the reference image's subject
cases.prompt: First describe the style of this image, then generate an image of a cafe in the same style.

cases.purpose: A generated image reaches the vision model, which checks each requested feature.
constraints: Returns one image of a cat wearing a red scarf
Returns a check stating whether there is a cat, whether it wears a scarf, and whether the scarf is red
The check agrees with the returned image
cases.prompt: Generate an image of a cat wearing a red scarf. Then check whether there is a cat, whether it is wearing a scarf, and whether the scarf is red.

cases.purpose: Two generated images are scored on the same criteria and one is recommended.
constraints: Returns two photos of cats
Gives each photo a score for clarity, subject completeness and composition
Recommends one of the two photos and gives a reason
cases.prompt: Generate two photos of cats. Score each photo for clarity, subject completeness, and composition, then recommend one and explain why. If the scores are tied, prefer the photo with higher clarity.
